basics.name: Michael Jereme Hancock
basics.headline: I'm just a guy who likes to tinker.
basics.tagline: I build self-hosted tools, AI experiments, and the occasional gloriously dumb project, then write about the whole mess.

sites.name: The Blog
sites.description: Long-form thoughts, tutorials, and write-ups on development, my homelab, and whatever I'm tinkering with this week.

sites.name: Dumb Projects
sites.description: A sandbox of experiments built with AI and gloriously dumb little apps built mostly for the fun of it.

sites.name: whoami
sites.description: My résumé reimagined as an interactive command line. Type a command, poke around, and explore who I am.

sites.name: RetroCities
sites.description: A nostalgic, GeoCities-style portfolio: neon colors, a scrolling marquee, beveled Windows 95 panels, and all the 90s charm.

projects.name: CLIX
projects.description: A Plex media player that lives entirely in your terminal. Browse and play your library without leaving the command line.

projects.name: homelab.md
projects.description: Offline-first homelab documentation that keeps your whole setup organized, searchable, and available even when the internet isn't.

projects.name: Stickies
projects.description: A sleek, single-file sticky-note whiteboard for quickly capturing ideas. No build step, no dependencies. Just open index.html in a browser.

projects.name: Marquee
projects.description: A web app for managing and curating your Plex poster art, making your media library look exactly the way you want.

projects.name: AI Game Collection
projects.description: A growing collection of small, games built using AI that you can jump into right from your browser.

projects.name: Random Goat
projects.description: Exactly what it sounds like: a delightfully pointless source of random goat GIFs whenever you need one.

skills.name: Languages
skills.evidence: Bash leads at 42 repositories, then JavaScript at 34, PHP at 33, and Python at 15, across 111 public repos.

skills.name: Backend & APIs
skills.evidence: Marquee's 106 classes run on Slim 4, with PSR-4 autoloading, PHP-DI wiring, Twig views, and a SQLite store.

skills.name: Frontend
skills.evidence: UnderCurrent is a React/MUI design system of roughly 100 components. homelab.md is one dependency-free file.

skills.name: Testing & Code Quality
skills.evidence: Marquee runs PHPStan at level 10, its strictest, with 74 test files over 106 source files, gated on every push.

skills.name: DevOps & CI/CD
skills.evidence: GitHub Actions lints, tests, builds, and ships multi-arch amd64 and arm64 images straight to Docker Hub.

skills.name: Linux & Self-Hosting
skills.evidence: UbuntuCE was a branded Ubuntu remix with hosted APT repos. A Pi cluster runs Prometheus and Grafana via Ansible.

skills.name: Plugins & Integrations
skills.evidence: Eight PHP plugins extend Bludit. Marquee and Glimpse read Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby, and pull art from TMDB.

skills.name: CLI & Shell Tooling
skills.evidence: CLIX and Ludanta are pure Bash with built-in updaters. fail2ban-tui is curses on the Python standard library.

skills.name: AI-Assisted Development
skills.evidence: Marquee is built spec-first with OpenSpec. AI Game Collection and Dumb Projects are portfolios of AI-built apps.

highlights: Build and maintain the UI for our customer-facing control panels.

highlights.text: One of the original developers of UnderCurrent, the Nexcess design system, and a primary contributor since: roughly 100 React components, a full theming layer, and its own Storybook.
